title: Three Brazilian UFO episodes overseen by the armed forces
place_text: Pará, São José dos Campos, Varginha, Brazil

tellings.quote: In Brazil alone, there are hundreds of episodes, but three at least were closely overseen by the armed forces and the Brazilian intelligence and defense systems.

plain: Brazil has had hundreds of UFO episodes, and at least three of them were closely followed by the country's armed forces and its intelligence and defence services. That is what Aldo Rebelo, who has served as Brazil's defence minister, tells Jesse Michels. The places tied to these episodes are Pará, São José dos Campos and Varginha, between 1970 and 1999. Coming from a former minister, the claim would mean Brazil's military treated the cases as real matters to investigate.
